_comment: SME sign-off ledger for production tutor content. A skill graph can only back an `authored` coverageMatrix cell if (a) its file's version is NOT a -draft, and (b) it has a non-empty signoffs entry below with at least one curriculum-designer review and (where applicable) a special-education reviewer. The promotion guard in scripts/curriculum-coverage-check.mjs enforces this. To promote a `scaffold` band to `authored`: review the seed file → bump its version from 0.1.0-draft to 1.0.0 → add a signoff entry here → flip the tutor's coverageMatrix entry. See docs/quality/tutor-k12-coverage-gap-plan.md.
